name: Hypodash
author: hypodash

sections.description:
Create ai generated blog posts with automatic scheduling and send to your WordPress site. Hypodash allows you to use your own AI provider keys to stay in control of usage costs.

How to get started

  • Sign up for Hypodash. (Hypodash is free for 7 days, after which you can choose our pro plan to gain access to automated article generation.
  • Install the plugin onto your WordPress website and follow the installation steps below.

Get Help

Contact us at support@hypodash.com for general questions or help.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the hypodash plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Settings -> Hypodash and copy your webhook path.
  4. Head over to your Hypodash settings page and paste in the webhook url into the the Webhook URL field.
  5. Try creating a new article and watch it automatically import into your WordPress site after generation.

short_description: Hypodash helps you create and publish AI articles, blogs, and images automatically using your own ai provider key.
